nodes.label: Noise.glsl (procedural noise header)
nodes.rationale: Hash, value noise and 4-octave FBM shared by the flame's vertex and fragment stages; the GPU stand-in for Blender's Clouds texture, which glTF cannot carry because it only animates nodes, skins and morph targets.

nodes.label: Hash / value noise / 4-octave FBM
nodes.rationale: Value noise smoothstep-interpolated between lattice points (plain linear interpolation would show the square grid), stacked into four octaves at doubling frequency and halving amplitude; one octave alone is too smooth to read as fire and the higher octaves put the wisps on the edges.

nodes.label: Procedural noise as a glTF-portable modifier stack
nodes.rationale: The flame was originally sculpted with Displace modifiers reading a Clouds texture through a turning Empty, which glTF cannot carry because it animates only nodes, skins and morph targets; evaluating equivalent noise per vertex and per pixel reproduces the idea without such a format.
